content: gt 1.3.0 (CRAN, 2026-01-22): full multi-format table output — HTML (native), LaTeX (as_latex()), Word/OOXML (as_word()), RTF (as_rtf()), PDF (via gtsave()). 17 hard imports including dplyr, htmltools, rlang, scales. 18 optional suggests. Heavy dependency footprint (~60 total transitive). LaTeX requires booktabs, caption, longtable, colortbl, array packages. Word/RTF now support multicolumn stub. Most powerful option for HTML tables; complex API with 180+ functions. For an R package, gt should be Suggests-guarded due to dependency weight.
